Timing advance.question: As a result, uplink transmissions arrive slightly before the nominal network frame timing, ensuring that the e_____B can begin the following downlink transmission at the correct scheduled time
Timing advance.fact: The timing advance granularity is 0.52 μ s {\displaystyle 0.52\,\mu s} , meaning that users whose distances from the eNodeB differ by less than 78 m {\displaystyle 78\,m} are assigned the same timing advance value. In TDD deployment mode, an additional 20 μ s {\displaystyle 20\,\mu s} offset is added to the timing advance correction to allow the eNodeB time to switch from reception to transmission.

Timing advance.subject: Telecom & Postal
Timing advance.question: By comparing the expected and actual reception timing, the e_____B estimates the timing error and signals a correction value to the UE
Timing advance.fact: During the connection, the timing advance is continuously adjusted based on measurements performed by the eNodeB on uplink signals transmitted by the UE. By comparing the expected and actual reception timing, the eNodeB estimates the timing error and signals a correction value to the UE.

Um interface.fact: The network sends a RR Paging Request message (GSM 04.08 Sections 9.1.22-9.1.23) over the PCH, using the subscriber's IMSI or TMSI as an address.
